competences.description: Attacks the enemy and removes one beneficial effect with a 50% chance. Decreases the enemy's Defense for 2 turns with a 30% chance when you attack on your turn.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy target to remove 1 beneficial effect, and suppresses the target (boss excluded) for 2 turns. Additionally increases your Attack Bar by 100% after using a skill. The suppressed target will have the HP reduced by 50% if the target uses a skill with cooldown time, and the used skill's cooldown time will be increased by 3 turns more than the maximum cooldown time.

effets.description: The HP is reduced by 50% of the MAX HP if the target uses a skill with cooldown time, and the MAX cooldown time of the used skill is increased by 3 turns.
Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.

competences.description: Increases your Attack Bar by 35% and decreases the cooldown time of [Karma] by 1 turn whenever enemies use a skill with cooldown time. Deals additional damage that's proportional to the enemy's MAX HP and increases the skill activation rate by 40% when attacking the suppressed Monster. [Automatic Effect]
